steps.text: LATE EVENING — You are back home and have a quiet moment to yourself.
I'm home
And I have a very serious question
I'm listening
Would you play something with me tonight?
Wait. You're asking ME to play?
Yes 😭
Why are you so surprised?
You never suggest it. It's usually me telling you about my games
I'm really happy you asked, actually
Really?
Yeah. I'd love to play with you
You always sound like you're having fun
I thought I'd like to try it with you instead of just hearing about it
Then let's find something we can both enjoy
What about that racing game you mentioned?
That would work. We can do a private race
Okay. But you have to explain the controls first
Deal. I'll send you an invite once you're ready
A LITTLE LATER — You both launch the racing game. Before starting, you explain the controls and let {{name:lena}} try a practice lap.
Ready. Please appreciate my concentration
Very professional. How's the practice lap going?
I've met the same wall three times
Brake before the corner, then turn
You're trying to do both at full speed
I thought speed was the point
Staying on the road helps too
Fine. One more practice lap
AFTER THE FIRST RACE
You finished so far ahead of me 😭
I've played it a lot more. Don't compare your first race to that
I also got stuck facing the wrong way
But you got around the last corner cleanly
That's the one you kept hitting in practice
I did notice that
See? You're already getting the timing
Okay. Again
Same track?
Yes. I have unfinished business with it
AFTER THE SECOND RACE — {{name:lena}} still finishes behind you, but completes the track with fewer crashes.
Still lost
Check your time, though
You finished much faster than the first race
And I only spun around twice
Exactly. You remembered to slow down before the sharp corners
I was repeating your instructions in my head
They worked. That was a much better lap
You're being nice because I'm your girlfriend
I'd tell you if you hadn't improved
The faster lap is because you drove better
Okay, that's a good answer ❤️
Want to stop or try a different track?
One more on this one
I want to see if I can do it without crashing at all
AFTER ONE LAST RACE
I nearly had it
You only clipped the barrier at the end
Because I got excited and forgot to brake
Your first half was really good. Keep doing that and the rest will follow
I want a rematch another night
I'd be very happy with that
You're still smiling about me asking, aren't you?
A little
I like getting to share this with you
Me too. Even if you're annoyingly difficult to catch
Now you understand why I always want one more round
Unfortunately, yes 😌
Did you play games like this when you were little?
Yeah. I'd lean sideways with the controller like that would help me turn
I did that tonight 😭
Then you have excellent instincts
Apparently everyone except the car understood what I wanted
We'll work on getting the car involved next time
Thank you for being patient with me tonight
I had a good time. You don't have to win for me to enjoy playing with you
I had fun too ❤️
Okay. Getting ready for tomorrow, then bed
Goodnight, love. Thanks for asking me to play
Goodnight ❤️ We'll do it again
